sections.title: Pieces of Heart
sections.note: 28 pieces, 18 in Hyrule and 10 in Lorule; every 4 add a heart. Link starts with 3 hearts, max 20.

items.name: Kakariko well
items.howTo: In the north-west of Kakariko Village, lift the two small rocks on the ledge above the well and drop in, or glide in from the ledge to the right holding a Cucco. Climb the stairs inside.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #1, IGN #1, Zelda Universe “Into the Well”. Needs: Power Glove (or a Cucco).

items.name: Cucco Ranch (Rooster)
items.howTo: Clear the Cucco-dodging game on Rooster, its third level (50 Rupees). Egg and Chick come first.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #2, IGN #7, Zelda Universe “Cucco Rush”. Needs: Rupees. Zelda Dungeon and Zelda Universe call it Cucco Rush, IGN Cucco Dash; Zelda Wiki and the sign say Cucco Ranch. Prize: 150 Rupees plus the piece the first time.

items.name: Sanctuary secret passage
items.howTo: Go back down the secret passage from the Graveyard to the Sanctuary. In the second room (the dark one with rats), climb to the upper ledge and Wall Merge along the north wall to the north-east corner.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #3, IGN #4, Zelda Universe “Sanctuary Passage”. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Behind the Blacksmith's Forge
items.howTo: Wall Merge along the west wall of the Blacksmith's Forge round to the back (north) of the house, step out and walk north.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #4, IGN #2, Zelda Universe “Blacksmith's Heart”. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Lost Woods log
items.howTo: Enter the Lost Woods from the north-east (near Rosso's house) and walk south-west to the broken log. Wall Merge into the narrow gap on its south side and walk through.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #5, IGN #3, Zelda Universe “Merging in the Woods”. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Rocks east of Hyrule Castle
items.howTo: Follow the road east from the castle gate north to its dead end and lift the ring of small rocks round the piece.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #6, IGN #9, Zelda Universe “Hyrule Castle Secret”. Needs: Power Glove.

items.name: Cave behind the waterfall
items.howTo: Jump into the river below Zora's Domain (north-east of the Witch's House) and swim into the cave behind the small waterfall.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #7, IGN #10, Zelda Universe “Waterfall Secret”. Needs: Zora's Flippers. Zelda Dungeon places the waterfall one screen south of Zora's Domain, Zelda Universe north-east of the Witch's House.

items.name: Rupee Rush (Hyrule)
items.howTo: Pay 50 Rupees, collect at least 100 Rupees and talk to the Rupee Rush Gal before the hidden 30 seconds run out. Finishing in the last seconds multiplies your take.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #8, IGN #8, Zelda Universe “Rupee Rush”. Needs: Rupees. Zelda Dungeon: under 3 seconds left doubles the Rupees, under 1 second triples them. Some Rupees are under tiles (Tornado Rod) or in boulders (Hammer).

items.name: Death Mountain ledge cave
items.area: Death Mountain (west of the Tower of Hera)
items.howTo: From the Tower of Hera go south-west. Wall Merge on the cliff above the cave on the narrow lower ledge, step out to drop in front of it and walk north through the opening.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #9, IGN #13, Zelda Universe “Death Mountain Merging”. Needs: Power Glove, Wall Merge. Zelda Universe: two hearts in the wall mark the spot.

items.name: Pillars south of Link's House
items.howTo: The piece south of Link's House sits among stone pillars. Go south-east to the two large pillars by the cliff, bomb between them and follow the cave west to come out beside it.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #10, IGN #12, Zelda Universe “Swamp Secret”. Needs: Bombs.

items.name: Cave south of the Eastern Palace
items.area: Eastern Ruins (south of the Eastern Palace)
items.howTo: Just south of the Eastern Palace, bomb the cracked rock (reach its ledge by Wall Merging from the level below, or later with the Power Glove) and Wall Merge inside to the piece.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #11, IGN #11, Zelda Universe “Eastern Cave”. Needs: Bombs, Wall Merge.

items.name: Staked-in piece south of the Eastern Palace
items.area: Eastern Ruins (south of the Eastern Palace)
items.howTo: One screen south of the Eastern Palace, in the south-east corner, pound the wooden stakes round the piece with the Hammer.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #12, IGN #6, Zelda Universe “Eastern Secret”. Needs: Hammer.

items.name: Pillar in the lava cave
items.area: Death Mountain (cave to Rosso's Ore Mine)
items.howTo: East of the Tower of Hera, Hookshot over the bridge and enter the lava cave signposted to Rosso's Ore Mine. From the central platform with the two Lynels, Wall Merge along the west wall onto a moving platform, then use the Hammer on the spring pads to bounce across to the pillar with the piece.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #13, IGN #14, Zelda Universe “Rosso's Ore Mine”. Needs: Power Glove, Hookshot, Hammer.

items.name: Hyrule Hotfoot
items.area: Lake Hylia (Racing Bro, north-east) to Rosso's house
items.howTo: Talk to the Racing Bro on the ledge in the far south-east of Hyrule (20 Rupees). Run to the other Racing Bro behind Rosso's house (the Miner's House): first in 75 seconds for 100 Rupees, then in 65 seconds for the piece.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #14, IGN #5, Zelda Universe “Race for the Heart”. Needs: Pegasus Boots. No riding Irene's broom in Hyrule. All three guides suggest the shortcut of stepping into Lorule, using the Bell there to fly to Skull Woods, and coming back to Hyrule through Rosso's house.

items.name: Stylish Woman's house
items.howTo: In Lorule, go to Thieves' Town's ruined house that stands where Kakariko's locked house is and take the Fissure in its wall. You come out inside the locked house, and the Stylish Woman blows Link a kiss.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #15, IGN #15, Zelda Universe “Stylish Trespassing”. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Front of the long house
items.area: Skull Woods (where Sahasrahla's house is in Hyrule)
items.howTo: Take the Fissure on the back of Sahasrahla's house in Kakariko. In Lorule, Wall Merge round the lone long house to its south (front) side.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #16, IGN #22, Zelda Universe “Northern Thieves' Town”. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Roof of the ruined house
items.area: Skull Woods (Abandoned Shack, Rosso's house in Hyrule)
items.howTo: The piece is on the roof of the ruin where Rosso's house is in Hyrule. Go south-east and climb the ladder, carry a Cucco to the north end of the high ledge and glide down right onto the piece; the slanted roof throws you off anywhere else.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #17, IGN #23, Zelda Universe “Fly like a Cucco”. Needs: A Cucco.

items.name: Fortune's Choice (Lorule)
items.howTo: Pay the Fortune's Choice Guy 200 Rupees and open three of the 15 chests. One chest holds the piece; keep playing until you find it.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #18, IGN #16, Zelda Universe “Fortune's Choice”. Needs: Rupees. After the piece the chest holds a Gold Rupee (Zelda Wiki). IGN lists this piece twice (its #16 and #29).

items.name: Rupee Rush (Lorule)
items.howTo: Pay 100 Rupees, collect at least 150 Rupees and talk to the Rupee Rush Guy before the hidden 30 seconds run out.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #19, IGN #17, Zelda Universe “Rupee Rush Take Two”. Needs: Rupees (Sand Rod helps). The Sand Rod reaches the most valuable Rupees (Zelda Wiki).

items.name: Octoball Derby
items.howTo: Pay 50 Rupees and score at least 100 in one game of 30 pitches. Hit three pots in a row to bring out a crow worth 20; hitting a crab resets the pots.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #20, IGN #18, Zelda Universe “Grand Slam”. Needs: Rupees.

items.name: Cave above the Graveyard
items.howTo: Take the Fissure inside the Sanctuary to Lorule. On the cliff at the north of Lorule's graveyard, bomb the cracked wall to uncover a Fissure, go through to Hyrule and enter the cave there.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #21, IGN #21, Zelda Universe “Graveyard Connection”. Needs: Bombs, Wall Merge. IGN doesn't mention the cracked wall.

items.name: Dark Palace maze
items.area: Dark Ruins (maze outside the Dark Palace)
items.howTo: In the guarded maze outside the Dark Palace, the piece is on a high walkway west of the palace entrance and east of the northern cell. Sneak past the guards with Wall Merge, or come back after the Dark Palace when the guards are gone.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #22, IGN #20, Zelda Universe “Dark Heart”. Needs: Wall Merge.

items.name: Cave east of the Swamp Palace
items.howTo: Buy a Big Bomb Flower (200 Rupees) south of Thieves' Town and lead it to the big cracked boulder in the south-east of the swamp round the Swamp Palace. Blow it up and enter the cave.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #23, IGN #19, Zelda Universe “Big Bomb Flower”. Needs: Big Bomb Flower (200 Rupees). Zelda Dungeon: the cave also holds 400 Rupees.

items.name: Spire east of the Tower of Hera
items.area: Death Mountain (spire east of the Tower of Hera)
items.howTo: The piece is visible on a spire east of the Tower of Hera. Take the Fissure by Rosso's Ore Mine to Lorule and enter the ice cave towards the Ice Ruins. At the big platform with the large Ice Gimos go west instead of north, take the northern route and use the Tornado Rod to hop onto the moving platforms above. Leave the cave, Wall Merge onto the pillar and take its Fissure back to Hyrule.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #24, IGN #28, Zelda Universe “Death Mountain Connection”. Needs: Hookshot, Tornado Rod, Wall Merge.

items.name: Treacherous Tower (Intermediate)
items.howTo: Clear the Beginner course (5 floors, 100 Rupees), then the Intermediate course (15 floors, 200 Rupees). The Devilish Girl gives the piece the first time.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #25, IGN #26, Zelda Universe “Treacherous Tower”. Needs: Rupees.

items.name: Turtle Rock west balcony
items.howTo: Inside Turtle Rock, on the first floor take the south-west door, use the see-saw to reach the warp tile, warp again into the lava room and cross it with Ice Rod blocks. The exit leads to the balcony with the piece.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #26, IGN #27, Zelda Universe “Turtle Rock”. Needs: Ice Rod. Visible from outside before you enter.

items.name: Misery Mire ledge via the desert
items.howTo: In Hyrule, climb the stairs at the north of the desert and build a sand path east with the Sand Rod. Bomb the boulder on the north wall (throw the bomb or set it on a sand column) to uncover a Fissure, and step through into Lorule.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #27, IGN #25, Zelda Universe “Misery Mire”. Needs: Sand Rod, Bombs, Wall Merge.

items.name: Cave by the Blacksmith's Forge
items.howTo: Lift the large rock in front of the cave outside the Blacksmith's Forge and go in.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #28, IGN #24, Zelda Universe “Blacksmith's Cave”. Needs: Titan's Mitt.

sections.title: Heart Containers
sections.note: One from each of the 10 dungeon bosses. Yuga at Hyrule Castle and Lorule Castle gives none.

items.name: Yuga
items.howTo: Boss of the Eastern Palace. Yuga drops it after Link learns to Wall Merge.

items.name: Margomill
items.howTo: Boss of the House of Gales.

items.name: Moldorm
items.howTo: Boss of the Tower of Hera.

items.name: Stalblind
items.howTo: Boss of the Thieves' Hideout.

items.name: Zaganaga
items.howTo: Boss of the Desert Palace, which stands in Hyrule's desert. The boss arena is in Lorule's Misery Mire, through a Fissure beyond the Big Key door.

items.name: Gemesaur King
items.howTo: Boss of the Dark Palace.

items.name: Arrghus
items.howTo: Boss of the Swamp Palace.

items.name: Knucklemaster
items.howTo: Boss of Skull Woods.

items.name: Grinexx
items.howTo: Boss of Turtle Rock.

items.name: Dharkstare
items.howTo: Boss of the Ice Ruins.
